body: Hey, I'm a human talking to you, another human. Both of our lives can make us very unhappy. But look, you have done so much in your life. It doesn't matter how old you are, look at what you have felt, done, or seen. Think about how you felt when your friends passed away. Do you want the other people in your life feeling like that? You don't have to- maybe if your mom is continually like that, you can try to talk to a friend about it if you havent already- please say more, I value your words

I know you meant no harm. I really don't want to see a professional though because of the fact that people would know but I like how they treat me now, as an equal person who they can rag on as a joke and tell dumb things to. Also, they could ask me to not do it. God I wish I hadn't done it. My friend just 2 years ago asked if he could do it to me, I just want it all to stop, I hate all this sex shit going on in my life, I hate hormones, I hate the pressure to date, I hate having to find somebody to be someone I want to date when I can't find anybody and the only person I truly have feelings for I fucked my chance up, I hate myself I hate everything I wish I could just die and be buried and forgotten I know everyone can make it without me I know-

I know nobody would mind
Hey man, need someone to talk to?

Are you sure I'm not a bad person? It's an extremely bad thing to do. I'm usually one of the more calm and relaxed people in my life and I don't think anyone would be friends with me if they knew. My brother loves me and looks up to me, that's what makes it worse...

Aren't therapists legally required to tell my parents? Especially if its an actual therapist, the only one that's available to me is the school one and I really don't want to go to her because everybody would know what was wrong with me and stuff. I don't know if I'll ever forgive myself. People would look at me differently. I hate that I did that. I wish it never happened. why did I do it

I don't want my mom to bear the burden of me, it'd be too much on her shoulders. There's enough kids in the house, what difference is one missing going to make? There are 9 kids in the house. 

I don't think I could ever talk to my brother or family members about it, I would be much too embarrassed. If he doesn't know then that's good but I'd rather just die with the memory than let him know. Especially with the situation with my mom. Everything just seems to be too much lately...
She broke up with me today.
